title: messaging: the QUIET_HOURS_OFF sentinel is spelled separately in the server resolver and the UI, with no pin tying the two
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · split off #36369 at ACCEPT 7101525096 on PR #36694, on seat 3's filing request (#32588 comment 7101547116). Origin: contract review 7076382062 on PR #36326. Parent topic #36240.

## What happens

The "quiet hours switched off" sentinel is written out twice:

- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/preference-resolver.ts` (server);
- the UI's `myPreferences.ts` (console).

Nothing fails if one spelling drifts. If they ever differ, a member who switches quiet hours off in the console would be read by the server as having a quiet-hours value, or the reverse, and nothing would surface the mismatch.

## Done when

- The sentinel has one source, shared by both, or a pin test fails when the two spellings differ.
- No behaviour change today.

Triage: lands in `area:workflow` · `domain:server` · `priority:p3` · Task · `pm:queue`; rationale: a latent drift between two copies of one constant. It has no effect today, so p3, but it is kept rather than closed because a future drift would silently change who receives notifications during quiet hours.
